test_method: Local companion served over loopback to real Chromium and Playwright WebKit engines. Offline verification stops and closes the HTTP server, then reloads the service-worker-controlled page. Browser tests do not establish physical iPhone Safari or installed PWA behavior.
android_fixture_provenance: Exact fictional JSON produced by the final native Android APK in an API29 software emulator: Juniper Café explicitly allowed, Share report tapped, sharing disclosure confirmed. The local exported JSON was retrieved without sending it externally, preserved verbatim as tests/fixtures/android-demo-report.json, then imported through the actual browser UI. This validates report interchange, not a radio scan or physical iPhone file transfer.
desktop_capture_provenance: Production Python CLI plus real TShark parsed tests/fixtures/synthetic-management.pcap. The management frames are synthetic; no live radio capture.
limitations: No physical iPhone or Safari installation tested.
